notes.title: Hardenville’s Journey So Far
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. It’s me, the developer, checking in and responding to some comments, reviews, feedback, criticism, and support I’ve received throughout our journey so far.

[h2][b]Let’s take a trip back in time![/b][/h2]

[h3][b]November 2021[/b][/h3]
I first discovered AVNs and was instantly hooked. I fell in love with some of the greatest games—many of the same ones you enjoy. At the same time, I played quite a few AVNs that weren’t great and thought to myself, "Wait, I could actually make something much better!"

[h3][b]December 2021[/b][/h3]
I downloaded Daz Studio, played around with it a bit, and saw the potential in this software.

[h3][b]January 2022[/b][/h3]
I started learning Ren'Py, watched tutorials, and gradually became more familiar with Python.

[h3][b]February 2022 – March 2023[/b][/h3]
During this period, I learned a lot about Daz, Ren'Py, and Blender. I also invested thousands of dollars into assets. Finally, I was ready to begin production on what is now known as Hardenville.

[h3][b]Late October 2023[/b][/h3]
Hardenville: The Prologue was released on Itch.io and Patreon, generating only a few purchases (three to five). The Steam version was supposed to launch simultaneously, but unfortunately, it remained stuck in the approval queue for three to four weeks—far longer than the usual 2-5 business days.

[h3][b]Early November 2023[/b][/h3]
Hardenville finally launched on Steam, and to my surprise, it was a big hit during the first weekend. It grossed almost $6,000 before Steam’s cut and taxes. I was excited about the future and believed I could already start working on this full-time.

Then, a wave of negative reviews came in: "It's too short," "Almost no content," etc. However, I had always been transparent about the average playtime on the store page.

[h3][b]Why Did I Release Hardenville on Steam When Only the Prologue Was Finished?[/b][/h3]
As a brand-new developer in the AVN industry—where new games release daily—it’s incredibly difficult to get recognized and build a player base. Releasing in Early Access on Steam helps gain visibility much faster. However, the trade-off is lower income on Patreon and other subscription-based platforms that many AVN developers rely on.

Hardenville is and will remain a single-purchase game. You get all episodes for one price—no extra fees, no paid DLC for more lewd scenes.

Unfortunately, after the big opening weekend, sales dropped drastically. In fact, from the Monday after release until today (March 2025), the game has earned less in total than it did during that first weekend alone. This financial reality has been a major factor behind the delays and unfulfilled promises.

[h3][b]Why Has Development Been Slower Than Expected?[/b][/h3]
At first, I thought I could work on this project full-time. But I quickly realized that wasn’t feasible yet. My hope is that after a few more episodes and more positive feedback, I’ll be able to make this my full-time job. If that happens, development will speed up significantly because I’ll be able to dedicate more time to it.

I’m a solo developer, and yes, I have missed deadlines—a lot. I sincerely apologize for that. That’s on me, and I truly wish things had gone differently. However, my goal remains the same: to deliver fantastic episodes that leave you feeling satisfied and make your hard-earned money spent on this game worth it.

It’s better to take the time to create something great—something I’m proud of—rather than rushing the process and leaving you uninterested in playing future episodes. Hopefully, once Hardenville is completed and I begin a new project, you’ll be able to look back and say:

"I really liked Hardenville, and I have high hopes for his upcoming game. The only issue was the delays—if the dev has mostly sorted that out, we’re in for a great experience!"

[h3][b]Addressing Concerns About the English Version[/b][/h3]
I’ve seen comments across the web mentioning that the English version had poor grammar. As of a recent update, the game has been fully proofread by a professional English proofreader.

[h3][b]Addressing Concerns About the Future of Hardenville[/b][/h3]
I know many people believe this project will end up abandoned like many other AVNs. Some even think I’m scamming them. Personally, this is really tough to hear. All I want to do is create a fantastic game that we can all enjoy, given the time I have available.

I will finish and deliver up to Episode 9, as promised. However, as with many Early Access games, development takes time, and delays happen.

[h3][b]When Is Episode 2 Coming?[/b][/h3]
I’ve been careful about sharing release dates, especially after the backlash over previous delays. However, I recently announced that Episode 2 is coming in May. Unfortunately, even when I provide a release window, I still receive negative feedback.

[h3][b]Final Thoughts[/b][/h3]
Please remember—I’m just one guy, working on my first release, doing something I love. I truly hope I can do this full-time in the future. More content will lead to better reviews, which will lead to more income, which will eventually allow me to make this my career.

To be clear, I haven’t taken a single penny from Hardenville as salary yet. Every dollar earned has been reinvested into the project.

I want you to know that I hear you, I care about your feedback, and I truly appreciate your patience, support, and for purchasing Hardenville.

[b]Let’s make this a fantastic game together![/b]

[h3][b]Hardenville[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010460/Hardenville/

[/list]

[b][i]This is an optional solution for Hardenville owners on Steam, but it will grant you additional privileges in the near future. Some Steam users felt overlooked in a previous Dev Log, and this is a way to address that.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Dev Log #13 | Episode 2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dev Log #13 | Episode 2[/b][/h3]
Published on Patreon, SubscribeStar, Itch.io, Discord, and Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/8488756aa308372e9ff9b773feebfae3262c3911.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introduction and Progress Update[/b][/h3]
Thank you for supporting my project, Hardenville. This past year has been a challenging journey, with more personal ups and downs than I anticipated. However, I’m thrilled by how much I’ve grown in coding and rendering since The Prologue. Several key improvements have been made for Episode 2, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved Field of View and Camera Positioning[/b]: Adjustments for a more immersive first-person experience.
[*] [b]Improved Lighting[/b]: Optimized lighting setups for more realistic and visually appealing scenes.
[*] [b]Better Character Rigging[/b]: Significant improvements to character bones and rigging, making it easier to create natural poses and expressions.
[*] [b]Rendering Optimizations[/b]: These changes lead to faster rendering times, allowing for quicker updates and progress.
[/list]

These improvements are all aimed at making Hardenville a more polished and enjoyable experience.

[h3][b]Episode 2: A Shift in Focus[/b][/h3]
Based on the feedback I received from Episode 1, I’ve made significant improvements to the script and overall flow for Episode 2. This episode will continue the detailed style you enjoyed in Episode 1 but with a new focus on romance and professionalism. The cringe humor from The Prologue has been greatly reduced, allowing for a more mature and engaging narrative. Inspired by titles like Summer Heat by Naughty Fox Games and Summer's Gone by Ocean, I’m committed to creating something uniquely Hardenville—a game that stands out for its style and emotional depth.

This new direction will make Hardenville more appealing to a broader audience while maintaining the essence of what makes it special.

[h3][b]The Importance of Episode 2[/b][/h3]
Delivering a perfect Episode 2 is crucial for the future of Hardenville. The success of this episode will directly impact my ability to attract more players, improve reviews, and generate the income needed to continue development at the pace this project deserves. If Episode 2 is well-received, I can dedicate more time to Hardenville, resulting in shorter development cycles between updates. Conversely, a lukewarm reception might force me to split my time with other jobs to maintain a steady income.

Rest assured, I will never abandon Hardenville, no matter what. However, the reception of Episode 2 will significantly influence how quickly and frequently I can deliver new content.

[h3][b]Financial Situation and Time Constraints[/b][/h3]
Currently, I’m in a tight financial situation, with credit cards maxed out because every cent has gone into this project. I can continue working on Hardenville as planned until November or December. My goal is to see Hardenville move from a Mixed to a Positive rating on Steam by the end of the year, thanks to the improvements and new content in Episode 2, including deeper romance and enhanced erotic elements.

[h3][b]Feedback and Release Schedule Adjustments[/b][/h3]
I’ve heard your feedback, especially from Patreon and SubscribeStar members who feel they aren't getting enough value. As a result, I’ll be focusing more on these platforms moving forward, sharing more frequent Dev Logs, polls, and development updates. Currently, these two platforms are my primary sources of revenue, with Patreon leading at $148 a month before taxes. My hope is that this increased focus will attract more members and provide the necessary support to sustain Hardenville’s development.

To manage expectations better, I need to set the release date for Episode 2 to simply "2024" and leave the release dates for Episodes 3 through 9 as TBA until I have a better handle on the time required for each episode.

[h3][b]Development Timeline and Rendering Goals[/b][/h3]
If everything goes according to plan, I’ll begin rendering later this week—at the latest, early next week. Episode 2 will feature nearly 1,000 renders and a few erotic animations for the sex scenes. Once the rendering phase begins, I expect to produce between 50 and 120 static renders each week, depending on other tasks such as coding and script development.

[h3][b]Member Benefits and Platform-Specific Updates[/b][/h3]
[b]Member Benefits:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Gold Members and Above[/b]: Receive major game updates, including the first releases of each episode in an Alpha state, one week before the stable release.
[*] [b]Silver Members and Above[/b]: Receive major game updates in a Beta state three days before the stable release.
[*] [b]Bronze Members, Steam, and Itch.io Owners[/b]: Receive the stable release one week after the Alpha, ensuring the highest quality upon release on platforms like Steam and Itch.io.
[/list]

All minor updates within episodes will be released simultaneously across all platforms, meaning only the initial episode releases will have Alpha and Beta stages.

To my Steam and Itch.io buyers, I want you to know that you’re not being left out. You will still receive updates, release notes, and major news like release dates. However, due to the different requirements for banners, image sizes, and file formats on these platforms, I’m focusing my detailed updates on Patreon and SubscribeStar. This approach allows me to dedicate more time to development while keeping you informed.

[h3][b]Many Thanks[/b][/h3]
Thank you again for your continued support! I am committed to making Hardenville the best it can be, and with your help, we can achieve great things. I’m excited to deliver an Episode 2 that exceeds your expectations and helps Hardenville reach new heights. 

[h3][b]Discord[/b][/h3]
Please remember to join our Discord channel with over 600 members to stay up-to-date on new development logs and polls!

notes.title: Hardenville Episode 1
notes.content:
It's been a long wait for this release. I've redone renders countless times and should have prioritized and been much more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/602db82565d0d33b03f9b0a81800c59bd64dc88e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Episode 1 Changes[/b][/h2]
The home alone party was originally planned to be in Episode 1, which was going to include some sex scenes. However, Episode 1 is ending after the preparty and right before the main party begins. This is to avoid rushing into scenes too early. Now, we have a calmer approach to Episode 2, which will be very lewd.

[h2][b]Focus of Episode 2[/b][/h2]
Episode 2 will only focus on the party, which will take place at home in one location. This should make development much faster. The planned release for Episode 2 is Fall 2024.

[h2][b]Music Library Overhaul[/b][/h2]
There are many new and changed things. Unfortunately, we needed to change the music library due to their recent policy change regarding media recommended for 18+ audiences. Luckily, we've found good alternatives, but they are much more expensive. The old music provider had a flat yearly subscription for roughly $400 for unlimited songs, whereas our new music provider costs $150-$200 per song. Additionally, thousands of dollars have been spent on new assets since The Prologue, while Steam sales from the last three months have been around $300 after taxes. I strongly believe this project won't become profitable for about a year, or maybe longer. So please keep in mind that while I will finish this project no matter what and will continue to invest in it, I ask for your patience.

[h2][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h2]
In one or two weeks, we'll update Hardenville to include French, German, Portuguese, and proofreading of English, as well as some cool new stuff.

I will likely update Hardenville with some small patches shortly to include more SFX and fix grammar mistakes.

[h3][b]Here's what's new and improved in Hardenville Episode 1 (0.2.0)[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 13 new gallery images
[*] 8 new Steam Achievements
[*] 2 new mini-games: handball shoot-out and never have I ever
[*] Added the skip option back in the preferences
[*] Can now choose whether to call the landlord and landlady by their name or relation
[*] Changed music provider, all new songs, now with song name and artist displayed
[*] Continuation of the story
[*] Corrected some screens that were not being pointed back to the correct screen
[*] Emojis in text messages
[*] Fixed a few persistent values not being saved
[*] New animations
[*] New contacts
[*] New residents
[*] Some new sound effects, with more to be added soon
[*] Slightly faster UI
[*] Slightly new UI look
[*] Twice the content of the Prologue
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Log #9 | Episode 1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Sneak Preview of What's to Come in the next big update, Episode 1[/b][/h3]

[b]The Prologue:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added emojis for text messages
[*] Improved support for gamepad
[*] Option to refer to the landlady as Johanna or the landlord as Tom in the dialogues
[*] Corrected grammar errors
[*] Fixed some screens that were not pointing back to the correct screen
[*] Faster menu with reduced lag
[*] Fixed some persistent values that were not being saved
[*] Made slight changes to the UI
[*] More achievements added (Steam): Porta-Potty Fun, Win Rock Paper Scissors
[/list]

[b]Episode 1:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added 2 new mini-games: handball and beer pong
[*] Included 2 new sex scenes
[*] Added new contacts
[*] Added new gallery images
[*] Introduced new residents: dog, cat, Hallie, Kiara
[*] Added new songs
[*] Added new text messages
[*] Added new achievements (Steam): Doggo (Name Your Dog), Goalie of the Day (Win The Shoot-Out Against Millie), Beer Pong Champion (Win the Beer Pong match), Cashed in V-Card (Best 20 Seconds of My Life), Complete Episode 1
[*] Added more SFX
[/list]

[h3][b]Work, work, render, render, code, code[/b][/h3]
I just wanted to tell you guys how amazingly patient you've all been. I know for a fact that it is very frustrating being promised a release date and it not being met. It is the worst feeling for me to disappoint you over and over again. Many have wondered why there's been so much delay, and that is a very fair question to ask. For those who don't know, I'm the sole developer. As a sole developer, I don't get that much input from others, which means that I can indeed change my mind a lot when it comes to content and how it's going to be portrayed. As has been said many times before, renders take a lot of time to render, and if renders don't look that great after all, I would need to change up a lot and then try again. With renders taking from 30 to 120 minutes, and then maybe altering some renders two or three times, that means that it doesn't always result in a lot of progress in a day. I do have some personal stuff here and there as well that I need to prioritize. But rest assured, my mind and focus are on Hardenville. I'm still super confident and eager to work and deliver new updates to you all. So please don't worry about the project being abandoned. I'm not a quitter! Just a tiny bit of a perfectionist when it comes to making the renders look good.

I have promised many more episodes for this year. And for each episode, I expect faster progress because of less extra tweaking on characters, environments, code functionality, and so on. Realistically, I probably would need to push Episode 5 to be the first episode launched in 2025, which means that I will work my butt off to deliver Episode 1, Episode 2, Episode 3, and Episode 4 to you all this year.

A massive thank you again for supporting this project. I'm using your hard-earned money on new assets and other Hardenville-related additions almost every single day. Once Episode 1 is launched, and I can begin work on Episode 2, I will consider doing some streams of showing you the creation of the new renders as other developers do if you're interested.

notes.title: Dev Log #7 | Episode 1
notes.content:
[h3][b]The Bucket Is Filling[/b][/h3]
While there is no doubt that Episode 1 is long overdue for its previous planned release, I can assure you that I'm working hard on a fantastic release. I fully understand that the longer the wait, the more frustrated some of you may become with the amount of time it's taking. At the same time, I'm thankful that the majority of you are still positive and are giving me the time I need to develop Hardenville. I'm spending much time building pieces to fit the story better than previously planned. I've listened to feedback across multiple sites, and much of it aligns with my own thoughts. Rest assured, I won't change Hardenville's story based on feedback I disagree with, but I will improve it with the many good suggestions I've received.

Jasmine is filling the bucket. What kind of devilish plan does she have in store?

The majority of the feedback regarding VR possibilities has been negative, as it would extend the development time of the episodes even further. I understand your concerns. Thank you all for your patience, feedback, and support

notes.title: Dev Log #5 | Episode 1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Calling All Translators![/b][/h3]
We're thrilled to announce that we're actively seeking translators from our community for multiple languages—a highly requested feature since the launch of The Prologue. With Hardenville, we are committed to enhancing the user experience and building a better Adult Visual Novel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/ecaed007c9490446cc44b09d6f5c0171101b08f5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/cb8ff25c4c26a16dc16f6dd624f976b7aa4f9c07.jpg[/img]

[b]Our primary focus is on finding translators for the following languages:[/b]
[list]
[*] English (proofreading, minimizing grammar mistakes)
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Russian
[/list]
[b]Secondary priorities include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Italian
[*] Portuguese
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[/list]

[b]Q: Who can apply as a translator for Hardenville?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Everyone!

[b]Q: What experience do I need?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Mastery of the target language and a strong understanding of English.

[b]Q: How can I apply?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Share a bit about yourself, the language you'd like to translate, and send us an email at [i][b]contact@joyfigames.com[/b][/i]

[b]Q: How many will be selected?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] We aim to have at least two individuals for each language.

[b]Q: When will I know if I've been selected as a translator?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] While we're prioritizing this process, it may take a few weeks. You'll receive a confirmation email promptly upon receiving your application.

[b]Q: What happens if I get selected?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Once selected, you'll gain access to an exclusive Discord channel for all translators and another exclusive channel specifically for translators of the chosen language.

[b]Q: What do I get in return?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Exclusive insights into Hardenville's development, early access to builds, and the highest tier on Discord, offering exclusive renders. In the coming months, we plan to extend additional perks such as Steam gift cards. [i]It's important to note that, initially, translation of Hardenville is a community project, and the benefits are not comparable to a permanent translator position.[/i]

[h3][b]New Equipment[/b][/h3]
After some time, we've received the majority of our PC parts for our second build, featuring a 14th gen i9, 128GB DDR5 RAM, 4TB of NVMe storage, and more. Unfortunately, the RTX 4090 I desire is still out of stock, leading me to temporarily borrow the RTX 3090 from my old rig. Despite having one PC rig to work on, it's already noticeably faster and smoother. The build took longer than expected, marking the first time in two or three years since the last rig.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/e6730c1989779d45c7dd6c43e85e9d93981f9236.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]VR[/b][/h3]
Additionally, I've invested in the Meta Quest 3 to explore the potential of Hardenville in VR. While it's too early to promise anything, I'll dedicate time after Episode 1's release to assess the viability of a VR version. If feasible, it will be released at no extra cost as a separate installation due to potential huge file size. I aim to render in 8k for impressive VR quality, with hopes of supporting the same game saves.
However, we may be getting ahead of ourselves. I'll provide an update in a few weeks or months regarding VR support.

[h3][b]New Website[/b][/h3]
I recently purchased the domains joyfigames.com and hardenville.com, completing the setup to look decent for now. Stay tuned for exciting plans for this website in the future.
Check out https://www.joyfigames.com/


[h3][b]Progress on Episode 1[/b][/h3]
Since the start of January, progress on Episode 1 hasn't met my initial expectations due to multitasking and the challenge of perfecting certain scenes. Some days, rendering takes 1-2 hours, and on completion, I may need to redo them to meet my standards. This can be frustrating, and I understand it may be for you too. However, I'm pleased with the current look, and with the website and new rig set up, progress will be faster moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/b1ff6b4201cd0211c8c7c0ce6c2393b61e6fb770.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/b5f183f3f8ca5fce4195de23686ac5f0bf97c1e7.png[/img]

[i]A burning question you likely have:[/i]
[b]Q: Will Hardenville Episode 1 still be released in January?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Right now, all I can say is that I truly hope so. I understand your frustration for delays, and believe me, nobody dislikes them more than I do.

Apologies for the lengthy post, but it's been two weeks since I've updated you, and there was more than the usual to share!

[h3][b]Hardenville[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010460/Hardenville/

notes.title: What's next for Hardenville
notes.content:
[b]Thank you![/b]
We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support and interest in our passion project, Hardenville.

We've always planned for the Prologue to be a short introduction to introduce players to the characters in Hardenville. A total of 10 chapters are planned, with the Prologue being the first and Episode 1 to 9 making up the remaining chapters. The Episodes will contain much more content and animations compared to the Prologue.

While we have noticed in reviews that some people find the Prologue too short, it was a deliberate decision to bring the game to Early Access on Steam with the first chapter. Typically, other visual novels don't do this until about mid-development cycle. We believed it was best to release the game early, gather feedback, and gain support to improve the game significantly. Our plans include translating the game into multiple languages, adding voice actresses at some point, expanding our team and much more.

At present, Hardenville is a solo endeavor led by Filip, a 25-year-old Norwegian developer.

[b]The planned release schedule for Hardenville episodes is as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hardenville Episode 1: Late December 2023 or early January 2024
[*] Hardenville Episode 2: Q1 2024
[*] Hardenville Episode 3: Q2 2024
[*] Hardenville Episode 4: Q3 2024
[*] Hardenville Episode 5: Q4 2024
[*] Hardenville Episode 6: Q1 2025
[*] Hardenville Episode 7: Q2 2025
[*] Hardenville Episode 8: Q3 2025
[*] Hardenville Episode 9: Q4 2025
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/dce13ecca65490052aa16bfd0868bc1a09277c44.png[/img]

[i]Please be aware that the planned release dates are subject to change if we require additional time for development.[/i]

[b]Freckles Upgrade[/b]
In our upcoming big release, Episode 1, we're making small adjustment to the freckles. It's not a major overhaul, just a change in color and a slight reduction in their intensity. These changes will only apply to Episode 1 and beyond, so there's no need to worry about us taking the time to redo all the renders in the Prologue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/4d9d6b7a558f23d9b3e3d99ed998050717126012.jpg[/img]

[b]Please join our Discord server to make a great community with us![/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/XPmezdYHeX]https://discord.com/invite/XPmezdYHeX[/url]

[i]Thank you so much for supporting our game, Hardenville.[/i]

[b][i]Much love from JoyFI Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Hardenville The Prologue Is Now Available
notes.content:
[b][h2]Exciting Announcement: Hardenville Is Now Available on Steam![/h2][/b]

The wait is finally over, and we are thrilled to announce that Hardenville is now officially available on Steam, featuring its first release, "The Prologue." This introductory chapter provides a sneak peek into the world of Hardenville, offering approximately 45 minutes of linear gameplay, with stunning visuals, enchanting music, a customizable in-game phone with over 30 background options, various apps, text messages, settings, and a collection of over 60 incredible songs. Throughout "The Prologue," be cautious with your choices, as you can keep track of your love interests using the Bonding app.

To celebrate this launch, we are offering a special 10% discount for the first week. After some Episodes, the standard price of $10 may see an increase, so we deeply appreciate your early support!

[h3]What to Expect from The Prologue[/h3]
[list]
[*] Approximately 45 minutes of linear gameplay
[*] Hundreds of renders
[*] Relationship customization options
[*] Immersive music and sound effects
[*] An in-game phone with various features
[*] Unlockable images in the Gallery
[*] Replay
[*] One animation (drone footage on the beach)
[*] Intimate scenes, including nudity, oral, kissing, masturbation, and an optional watersport scene
[/list]

[h3]What's on the Horizon[/h3]

In the upcoming releases, starting with Episode 1, expected to launch in late December or early January, you can look forward to double the content of "The Prologue," including more intimate scenes, animations, collectibles, and much more!

Our plan includes a total of 9 substantial Episodes in Hardenville Season 1. By purchasing the game now, you'll gain access to all future Episodes as they become available.

[h3]What's in Store for the Future of Hardenville[/h3]
[list]
[*] Harem
[/list]

[h3]What You Won't Find in Hardenville[/h3]
[list]
[*] NTR
[/list]

[h3]Why Your Support Matters to Us[/h3]

With your support, we can enhance the game further. We are not only equipped with our current PC setup featuring an RTX 3090 but also plan to acquire another PC with an RTX 4090. This will allow us to utilize the RTX 4090 for rendering images and the RTX 3090 for animations, leading to increased productivity and the ability to deliver more content at a faster pace.

This release marks our first step into this venture, and we promise to complete Hardenville Season 1. We have spent years learning Ren'Py and Daz Studio, and we can't wait to share our creation with you.

[h3]Join Our Discord[/h3]

If you haven't already, we invite you to join our Discord community:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/XPmezdYHeX]https://discord.com/invite/XPmezdYHeX[/url]

[b][i]With Love from JoyFI Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Hardenville: Launch Date, Discounts, Gameplay Sneak Peeks, and More!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey everyone![/b]
[/h1]

[b]In this post, we're excited to delve into:[/b]

[list]
[*] Developer's personal insights
[*] Final release date
[*] Release discount offer
[*] Enhanced phone-system functionality
[*] Introduction of music and SFX
[*] Improved relationship manager
[*] Introducing pets to liven up your in-game home
[*] Updated visuals and screenshots
[*] And so much more!
[/list]

[b]Straight from the Developer's Desk:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/6c157946d6b7796e016c71ee4632d91088ff2e1f.png[/img]

As Hardenville's sole developer, I'd like to start by thanking you for your patience and support since my last update in April. After a taxing exam period that lasted until mid-June and a well-deserved break in July, I'm back, fully charged and working tirelessly to bring Hardenville to you!

Hardenville: The Prologue will see the light of day in early October.

[b]As we inch closer to the release, it seems fitting to introduce a release discount dependent on wishlists! Check it out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/b5b25b991b4b3f01f705674fdeb5a6b4ecce67ac.png[/img]

A year ago, Hardenville was envisioned as a simple linear gameplay with minimal player interaction. Today, with enhanced skills and a clearer vision, we're excited to include innovative features for an elevated visual novel experience. Delays, after all, can often be a blessing in disguise!

[b]Intricate Phone-System:[/b]

The game interface now features a phone at the bottom right corner. It remains idle and unobtrusive, but hover over it, and it reveals the current date and time in Hardenville! Clicking on it expands to a large display with apps, a text messaging system, a store, options for background change, and more. Stay tuned for additional features in the full version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/f7a04edbd54f4ae1dcdca362d18e2dc02256e139.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/7b8e33275307c4ab5d6fcc6d810bd27e8faced02.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/2fa6fbec2ef446a33c83c2cf19d2e87fad86bbfd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/78b949d89847d12c295a1b87bf76f16b8d632dfe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/b8d5166d8270940086934833e1a4a459d018c344.png[/img]

[b]Music and SFX:[/b]

We're ecstatic to announce the inclusion of music and SFX at launch. While Epidemic Sound did not align with our adult content, Artlist graciously stepped up to the plate.

[b]Redefining Relationship Management:[/b]

Many adult visual novels offer relationship renaming, but we've pushed the envelope to allow continuous edits from both the main and in-game menus. Your changes will always be saved and stored!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/398950d5fb333b51c03f90d030541cb542a1d077.png[/img]

[b]Welcoming Furry Friends:[/b]

Add a touch of warmth to your gaming experience with your in-game house pets – a cat and a dog! You can even name them! While they won't significantly alter the storyline, they will definitely make cameo appearances throughout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/aa03d827cc94b3f1a12b3e331316145436e97f35.jpg[/img]

[b]Revamped User Interface:[/b]

In response to your valuable feedback from our January tests, we've redesigned the menus for a cleaner, more intuitive user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/ba8e7bbfe36166f75b3d162ea96a3e33716003bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/9a570be8413c21abe6cc878ec94124f7f95a6f04.jpg[/img]

[b]Hardenville Prologue Focus:[/b]

Experience the beauty and drama of a wedding in our Prologue! We invite you to feast your eyes on these renders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/26380e75b197b6d8e71e72397af19f76adfcc345.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/aef918905f9049a5ce58dc5c15f9bac2c2da4b70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/084dd6c88002d770e063466cc2257a5126d12af9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/64f0c1a00945838bd2de5bcfc3bca1af1ca6d791.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/0a05769f0e918ae26d33aa2aad8488f514355256.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/c6912bab80fa63b7ea345e00dca7f8a1e66e64bd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/08f1c395e5555023ae9f48619ac3b2e2175014e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/2a8a2d8d8af188e8d0b95d633d7df618d881fffa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/1b46ae6b05184f9e5c0c8b6282615a320de3287f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/b1cf56ff1c679411e60a08fc8a56dc898339ea89.jpg[/img]

[b]Gratitude for Early Supporters:[/b]

Early contributors on Patreon or Subscriberstar who've supported us before July 31 will receive a complimentary copy of Hardenville on Steam prior to release. It's our way of expressing gratitude for your faith in us.

[b]A New Hardenville Poster:[/b]

Finally, we're delighted to share a new poster for Hardenville! Do take a look and let us know your thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/a762f97607192a918cd8c32af647f7c2fe76d7e2.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for journeying with us as we shape Hardenville into an exciting adventure!

[b][i]Much love from JoyFI Games[/i][/b]
